note: The retrieval suite at RetrievalSettings() defaults, over the corpus whose digest is corpus_sha256. CI fails if the corpus changes, if any metric gets worse, if a case that passes here starts failing, or if a known-failing case fails in any way not listed under its `failures`. Regenerate deliberately, with the reason in the commit.

rec_001.reason: The spec E.3 merge keeps each memory's maximum score, so recency cannot lift the newer of two equal lexical matches; ties go to the older memory_id. A spec question, put to Janu.
